name: 2 John
lede: The sixty-third book of the Bible, in full: the elder's letter unto the elect lady and her children — whom I love in truth; I rejoice greatly that I have found certain of thy children walking in truth; that we love one another; many deceivers are gone forth into the world; look to yourselves; receive him not into your house; I hope to come unto you, and to speak face to face; the children of thine elect sister salute thee, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: The Elect Lady
books.blurb: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in truth; grace, mercy, peace; I rejoice greatly that I have found certain of thy children walking in truth; not a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another; many deceivers are gone forth into the world; look to yourselves, that ye lose not the things which we have wrought; whosoever abideth in the teaching hath both the Father and the Son; receive him not into your house; I would not write them with paper and ink, but I hope to speak face to face; the children of thine elect sister salute thee.
